caption: The drawing depicts a single, translucent green glass bowl with a wide, flared rim and a narrow base that expands into a short, rounded foot. The bowl's body features decorative, raised serpentine or wave-like patterns that are integrated into the surface, giving it a textured appearance. The shading and highlights on the glass emphasize its transparency and thickness in certain areas, particularly around the patterns and the rim. The drawing uses various shades of green, ranging from light to dark, to convey depth and the reflective quality of the glass. The background is plain and unadorned, with a neutral off-white color that contrasts with the green bowl and helps it stand out. There are no other objects or decorative elements present in the composition.
title: Bowl
